notes.title: Update 0.6 - Solo mode
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the new update for Staying Fresh!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916055/7087d8bb98f71b98d4cf42e4d854fb4b953d3fe6.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.51 - Hints, lots of hints
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the new update for Staying Fresh!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916055/ebb65f37d9547c5d7a6909c8be55b312d0bc4c99.png[/img]

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*] The hint mode now shows not only enemy movement zones but also their attack range.
[*] Recently found recipe book page fragments are now visible.
[*] Added hints about the conditions required to find missing recipe book page fragments.
[*] Added stats that will be useful for future achievements and for fine-tuning game balance.
[/list]
[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalancing and simplification — numerous adjustments.
[*] Added new animations and tweaked the behavior of some enemies.
[*] Progressive enemy spawning in Danger Mode: if there are already many enemies, new ones won’t spawn in large numbers.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Brought back the laser — it disappeared in a previous update.
[*] Many graphical fixes (characters, ingredients, environment).
[*] The active enemy was not always displayed in hint mode — fixed.
[*] Gamepad stick normalization.
[*] Fixed cursor movement snapping to the player when using a gamepad.
[*] Improved cursor display.
[*] Text and translation fixes.
[*] Fixed the endless mode breaking after completing the game.
[*] Recipe book page fragments now correctly add upon defeating a boss.
[*] Various minor fixes.
[/list]
Stay Tuned, Stay Fresh!

notes.title: Endless Mode Update - Version 0.5
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the new big update for Staying Fresh!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916055/ee822fab9ec031431089d0d83b1a362c2904d365.png[/img]

[b]Endless Mode[/b]
Now you can continue playing after beating the game with your upgraded team or start a new run in Endless Mode using a unit that has already completed the game.

[b]New Gameplay Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can create a unit using random ingredients. It won’t be very strong, but it might come in handy in certain situations.
[*] You can throw ingredients at enemies!
[/list]
[b]New content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a cursor under the active unit – many of you asked for this!
[*] Introduced various new jars of cereal as decorative kitchen elements.
[*] Added napkins – more decorative kitchen details.
[*] Level 3 is now more varied: even the water color in the sink can change.
[*] Reduced salt shaker size.
[*] Ingredient names are now displayed in the bucket.
[*] Tons of small improvements and UX/UI fixes.
[*] Adjusted balance – the game is now slightly less hardcore.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect hiding of sticky notes when some units were in a group.
[*] Added new animations for certain units.
[*] Fixed ingredient positions in the bucket.
[*] Corrected wrong damage values for certain attacks.
[*] Adjusted attack animation directions for some units.
[*] Improved attack and hit animations.
[*] Fixed and added various sounds, as well as adjusted volume levels.
[*] Resolved an issue where the big HP bar sometimes wouldn’t disappear.
[*] Fixed ingredient layering and positioning.
[*] Adjusted collectible item positions.
[*] Sorry, but I fixed the bug that allowed you to continue the same run after losing if the game was restarted.
[*] Various optimizations.
[*] And many other small fixes I’ve probably forgotten to mention!
[/list]
Stay Tuned, Stay Fresh!

notes.title: Update 0.42 - Localization, Tutorial and Gamepad support
notes.notes:
Hello, welcome to the new update to Staying Fresh!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916055/c576f501ec473991445ce53b0058043a4220821f.png[/img]

I've added French, German, Spanish, Italian and Russian languages! Japanese and Chinese will be added later. The translation is not accurate and I would be happy if you could point out the errors.
I've added tutorial on movements, basic commands and sticky note using. Garden tutorial is next.
Also I added support of Xbox and PS controllers! It is much better to play on Steam Deck but full support will come later too. I'm working on it.

Also there are little updates:
[list]
[*] New rice seeds and plant for the garden
[*] Updated button design
[*] Tons of ux ui little improvements
[*] Potato plant disappearing is fixed
[*] Little balance improvements
[*] Bugfixes, i fixed a lot but I'm not sure was these bugs new or old
[/list]

Endless mode and new ways to use ingredient on the way! Stay tuned, stay fresh!

notes.title: Update 0.41 - First update! I've added settings
notes.notes:
Hello, welcome to the first update to Staying Fresh!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916055/f33e9aba596b11d94731757d6d13aedf29f4b82f.png[/img]
[h3]Updates[/h3]
I've added settings. Finally you can set music and Sound volume, set shader/vfx quality. Later I will optimize them but now you can set low quality or disable it if you have freezes in "fog" levels and in the garden. Also CRT shader can be enabled or disabled. More CRT shaders on the way

Balance improvements:
[list]
[*] First levels after the first boss became easier
[*] Enemies spawn at a distance from each other so that there is not a large crowd at the beginning of the level
[*] Little improvements
[/list]
Fixed bugs:
[list]
[*] map generator: fixed hardlock generations on some levels
[*] map generator: fixed enemy or ingredient appearance in solid objects
[*] fixed unmovable cell in larva's crowd that can lock levels too
[*] question mode is not check non visible units
[*] movable fields is not appearing in question mode out of visible space
[*] fixed distance of hiding tiles for some levels
[*] wrong music playing after clicking the continue button
[*] and more little stuff I've forgotten
[/list]

Endless mode, new ingredient usages and language settings on the way! Stay tuned, stay fresh!
